summary: Numeric.minimumf was already repaired on the prepared base through ArithValue.minimumf and retained coverage now exercises it on GPU. Vector.reduce still mapped floating max to non-NaN-propagating MAXNUMF while min mapped to NaN-propagating MINIMUMF; floating max now maps to MAXIMUMF so both reductions consistently propagate NaN.

534 focused expression, vector, scalar extrema, IR, and GPU regression tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-63f04392c22d/raw/full-focused-suite.txt
